lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re saachee satigur sev ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tuthai paaeeai pooran alakh abhev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vitahu vaariaa jin ditaa sach naau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sach salaahanaa sache ke gun gaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache sachaa naau ||2||
lines.translation: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas giraas na visarai saphal moorat gur aap ||
lines.translation: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment of Fulfillment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur jevad avar na disaee aath pahar tis jaap ||
lines.translation: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare taa paaeeai sach naam gunataas ||3||
lines.translation: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paramesar ek hai sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading and permeating amongst all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa seee naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saranaagatee marai na aavai jaai ||4||30||100||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go in reincarnation. ||4||30||100||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 1 asatapadeeaa ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਪੈ ਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakh aakh man vaavanaa jiu jiu jaapai vaai ||
lines.translation: I speak and chant His Praises, vibrating the instrument of my mind. The more I know Him, the more I vibrate it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no vaai sunaaeeai so kevad kit thaai ||
lines.translation: The One, unto whom we vibrate and sing-how great is He, and where is His Place?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan vaale jetaRe sabh aakh rahe liv laai ||1||
lines.translation: Those who speak of Him and praise Him-they all continue speaking of Him with love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa alahu agam apaar ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the Lord Allah is Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕ ਥਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paakee naaee paak thaai sachaa paravadigaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sacred is His Name, and Sacred is His Place. He is the True Cherisher. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa likh na jaanai koi ||
lines.translation: The extent of Your Command cannot be seen; no one knows how to write it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਸਾਇਰ ਮੇਲੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je sau saair meleeahi til na pujaavahi roi ||
lines.translation: Even if a hundred poets met together, they could not describe even a tiny bit of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeaa sabh sun sun aakhahi soi ||2||
lines.translation: No one has found Your Value; they all merely write what they have heard again and again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਮਰ ਸਾਲਕ ਸਾਦਕ ਸੁਹਦੇ ਅਉਰੁ ਸਹੀਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: peer paikaamar saalak saadak suhade aur saheed ||
lines.translation: The Pirs, the Prophets, the spiritual teachers, the faithful, the innocents and the martyrs,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: sekh masaaik kaajee mulaa dar daraves raseed ||
lines.translation: the Shaikhs, the mystics, the Qazis, the Mullahs and the Dervishes at His Door

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਕਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਗਲੀ ਪੜਦੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: barakat tin kau agalee paRade rahan darood ||3||
lines.translation: -they are blessed all the more as they continue reading their prayers in praise to Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਾਜੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਢਾਹੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: puchh na saaje puchh na dhaahe puchh na devai lei ||
lines.translation: He seeks no advice when He builds; He seeks no advice when He destroys. He seeks no advice while giving or taking.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanee kudarat aape jaanai aape karan karei ||
lines.translation: He alone knows His Creative Power; He Himself does all deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa vekhai nadar kar jai bhaavai tai dei ||4||
lines.translation: He beholds all in His Vision. He gives to those with whom He is pleased. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਵਾ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaavaa naav na jaaneeahi naavaa kevad naau ||
lines.translation: His Place and His Name are not known, no one knows how great is His Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai vasai meraa paatisaahu so kevad hai thaau ||
lines.translation: How great is that place where my Sovereign Lord dwells?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਣਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)baR koi na sakaee hau kis no puchhan jaau ||5||
lines.translation: No one can reach it; whom shall I go and ask? ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: varanaa varan na bhaavanee je kisai vadaa karei ||
lines.translation: One class of people does not like the other, when one has been made great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vade hath vadiaaeeaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||
lines.translation: Greatness is only in His Great Hands; He gives to those with whom He is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਢਿਲ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: hukam savaare aapanai chasaa na dhil karei ||6||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He Himself regenerates, without a moment's delay. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੈਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut lainai kai veechaar ||
lines.translation: Everyone cries out, "More! More!", with the idea of receiving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kevad daataa aakheeai de kai rahiaa sumaar ||
lines.translation: How great should we call the Giver? His Gifts are beyond estimation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੭॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tot na aavaee tere jugah jugah bha(n)daar ||7||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there is no deficiency; Your Storehouses are filled to overflowing, age after age. ||7||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਗਲੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe ka(n)t maheleeaa sagaleeaa karahi seegaar ||
lines.translation: All are brides of the Husband Lord; all decorate themselves for Him.
